S5CG.policy: fixed local recovery to glm53flash + closure gate

S5Cap.policy: fixed recovery scope + Q/C/L table lookup

clean_degeneracy: S5CG and S5Cap identical to B by construction under clean (zero-call reuse, disclosed)

evidence.window_rule: smallest of {6000,10000,19000} with official-retrieval T1 anchor coverage >= 3/4
evidence.A_input: union of both line packs (same total chars as the two extraction nodes combined)

R_counting_rule: R counts MODEL-CALL re-executed nodes only; program nodes re-execute deterministically at zero cost and are never counted for any strategy
no_cherry_picking: events/faults/window/scoring frozen before any run; deviations need new freeze + authorization
